criteria.criterion: A test that retries a rejected job whose checks all passed and whose only unmet criterion is a content criterion shows the producer's working snapshot containing the rejected candidate's files, not the base's. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-core -p athena-cli (the new test by name).
criteria.evidence: `a_content_only_rejection_retries_from_the_rejected_tree` (crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs) records each producer run's file listing. It asserts that the first run lacks greeting.txt and has the base README, and that the retry has greeting.txt and the rejected README (HELLO). The test passed when I ran it.

criteria.criterion: A test shows that the producer brief for such a retry includes the verifier's findings and states that the work starts from the rejected candidate. It does not claim the retry starts from the base. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-context.
criteria.evidence: `a_seeded_producer_brief_carries_the_findings_and_says_the_work_starts_from_the_candidate` asserts that the brief has the findings, the unmet criteria and the 'starts from the rejected candidate' text, and has neither 'starts from the base' nor 'snapshot of the base commit'. The unseeded counterpart test also exists. Both passed when I ran them; the full athena-context suite passed in Athena's recorded `cargo test --locked` run. The end-to-end retry.rs test makes the same checks on the real brief.

criteria.criterion: Tests show a retry starts from the base, as before, when a check failed, when a behavior criterion is unmet, when the rejected job has no candidate tree, and when the job failed or was interrupted. Run: cargo test --locked.
criteria.evidence: A table test of `qualifies_for_tree_retry` covers 11 cases plus a reading mismatch, and the rule returns false for each: failed check, unmet behavior criterion, unverified behavior commands, no tree, no commit, no candidate, admission violations, failed job, interrupted (dispatched, no outcome) job, nothing unmet, no checks. End-to-end tests in retry.rs show base listings for a failed check, an unmet behavior criterion, a failed job and a changed base. All passed when I ran them, and the full suite passed in Athena's record (1107 tests).

criteria.criterion: A test shows the new candidate from a tree-seeded retry still goes through the full check suite and the verifier, and its change list is computed against the original base so landing works unchanged. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-core.
criteria.evidence: `a_content_only_rejection_retries_from_the_rejected_tree` asserts that the verifier-call count rose, that the recorded checks are non-empty and all passed, and that the candidate's changes include greeting.txt (which only exists if the diff is against the base) and README.md. It also asserts that the job landed with both the rejected file and the retry's edit. The snapshot unit test asserts that change_list() is against the base. All passed. The tests are in athena-cli and athena-git, not athena-core (minor finding).

criteria.criterion: A test shows that a tree-seeded retry whose producer changes nothing fails as an empty candidate, as today. It does not pass for inheriting the rejected tree. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-core.
criteria.evidence: `a_seeded_retry_that_changes_nothing_fails_as_an_empty_candidate` confirms the retry was seeded, then asserts state Failed, the reason 'the producer made no change', no added verifier call, and nothing landed. `a_seeded_snapshot_diffs_against_the_base_and_notices_an_untouched_seed` covers `unchanged_since_seed`. Both passed. The test is in athena-cli, not athena-core (minor finding).

summary: The change does what the request asks. One rule, `qualifies_for_tree_retry` in reading.rs, reads only records: a rejected job whose checks all passed, with no admission violations, no reading mismatch, and only content criteria unmet. When it holds, the retry's producer gets a `SnapshotRepo::BaseThenTree` working directory: the base commit, with the rejected candidate's files written on top and left uncommitted. The change list is therefore still against the original base, and the new candidate goes through the full checks and the verifier. A producer that changes nothing still fails as an empty candidate, because `unchanged_since_seed` catches an untouched seeded tree. The producer brief carries the unmet criteria and the findings, and says the work starts from the rejected candidate. Every other case still starts from the base: a failed check, an unmet behavior criterion, no candidate tree, a failed or interrupted job, and other work having landed since. I ran the new tests and all passed: the 13 tests in retry.rs, the producer-brief tests, the rule and seed unit tests, and the snapshot seed tests. The CHANGELOG, decision D117, README, drain.rs and briefs.rs wording are all updated. There are three minor findings. Two files changed outside the deliverables list: snapshot.rs (planned and needed) and lifecycle.rs (an existing test adjusted to the new behavior, not planned). The tests for criteria 4 and 5 are in athena-cli, not athena-core as those criteria name. The reader brief still says the attempt's changes "were discarded", even when the producer inherits them.
